categories.name: Image Tools
categories.description: A focused Image Lab for compressing, resizing, converting, cropping, framing, comparing, combining, and preparing visual content in your browser.
categories.description_en: A focused Image Lab for compressing, resizing, converting, cropping, framing, comparing, combining, and preparing visual content in your browser.

categories.name: PDF Tools
categories.description: A focused PDF Lab for creating, converting, editing, organizing, and exporting documents in your browser.
categories.description_en: A focused PDF Lab for creating, converting, editing, organizing, and exporting documents in your browser.

categories.name: Marketplace Tools
categories.description: Commercial tools for sellers and small businesses to calculate prices, costs, fees, margins, and profit.
categories.description_en: Commercial tools for sellers and small businesses to calculate prices, costs, fees, margins, and profit.

tools.name: Image Compressor
tools.description: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and other browser-supported images locally with quality, format, resize, target-size controls, side-by-side comparison, camera input, and fast export.
tools.description_en: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and other browser-supported images locally with quality, format, resize, target-size controls, side-by-side comparison, camera input, and fast export.

tools.name: Image Resizer
tools.description: Resize one or more images online for free to exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio lock, contain, cover, stretch, quality, background, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Resize one or more images online for free to exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio lock, contain, cover, stretch, quality, background, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Image Converter
tools.description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images online for free in batches with optional resizing, quality control, rotation, flip, grayscale, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images online for free in batches with optional resizing, quality control, rotation, flip, grayscale, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Image Cropper
tools.description: Crop images online for free to precise aspect ratios with drag positioning, rotation, flip, quality controls, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Crop images online for free to precise aspect ratios with drag positioning, rotation, flip, quality controls, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Watermark Studio
tools.description: Add text watermarks online for free with precise styling, positioning, rotation, repeat patterns, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Add text watermarks online for free with precise styling, positioning, rotation, repeat patterns, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Image Metadata Cleaner
tools.description: Re-encode one or more images locally to create fresh JPG, PNG, or WebP copies while comparing the original and cleaned outputs.
tools.description_en: Re-encode one or more images locally to create fresh JPG, PNG, or WebP copies while comparing the original and cleaned outputs.

tools.name: Color Palette Extractor
tools.description: Extract dominant image colors with HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS, JSON, and gradient output using local browser analysis.
tools.description_en: Extract dominant image colors with HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS, JSON, and gradient output using local browser analysis.

tools.name: Social Media Image Resizer
tools.description: Create exact social-media image sizes with platform presets, cover or contain framing, optional text, and local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Create exact social-media image sizes with platform presets, cover or contain framing, optional text, and local browser processing.

tools.name: Favicon Generator
tools.description: Generate favicon.ico, browser PNGs, Apple Touch Icon, and PWA icons from one image with local browser processing.
tools.description_en: Generate favicon.ico, browser PNGs, Apple Touch Icon, and PWA icons from one image with local browser processing.

tools.name: JPG → PDF
tools.description: Convert multiple JPG/JPEG images into one PDF with reordering, page-size, orientation, margins, JPEG quality, camera input, and local export.
tools.description_en: Convert multiple JPG/JPEG images into one PDF with reordering, page-size, orientation, margins, JPEG quality, camera input, and local export.

tools.name: PDF → JPG
tools.description: Convert PDF pages to JPG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, JPG quality, progress, and downloadable results.
tools.description_en: Convert PDF pages to JPG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, JPG quality, progress, and downloadable results.

tools.name: PDF → PNG
tools.description: Convert PDF pages to PNG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, progress, and downloadable results.
tools.description_en: Convert PDF pages to PNG locally with page selection, live preview, rendering resolution, progress, and downloadable results.

tools.name: PNG → PDF
tools.description: Convert PNG images to PDF locally with multi-image upload, page sizing, orientation, fit modes, margins, quality, progress, and downloadable output.
tools.description_en: Convert PNG images to PDF locally with multi-image upload, page sizing, orientation, fit modes, margins, quality, progress, and downloadable output.

tools.name: Merge PDF

tools.description_en: Merge multiple PDF files locally with ordering controls, progress, page counts, downloadable output, and no artificial quotas.

tools.name: Split PDF
tools.description: Split PDF locally into one-page files or a selected page range with progress, individual downloads, batch download, and no artificial quotas.
tools.description_en: Split PDF locally into one-page files or a selected page range with progress, individual downloads, batch download, and no artificial quotas.

tools.description_en: Rotate all PDF pages or selected page ranges by 90, 180, or 270 degrees with local processing, preview, progress, and download.

tools.name: Insert Pages
tools.description: Insert pages from one PDF into another locally with before, after, or end placement.
tools.description_en: Insert pages from one PDF into another locally with before, after, or end placement.

tools.name: Duplicate Pages
tools.description: Duplicate selected PDF pages locally and export a new document with controlled repetitions.
tools.description_en: Duplicate selected PDF pages locally and export a new document with controlled repetitions.

tools.name: Delete Pages
tools.description: Remove selected PDF pages locally with page ranges, document map, validation, progress, and clean export.
tools.description_en: Remove selected PDF pages locally with page ranges, document map, validation, progress, and clean export.

tools.name: PDF Watermark
tools.description: Add a text watermark to every PDF page with position, size, color, opacity, rotation, preview, and local export.
tools.description_en: Add a text watermark to every PDF page with position, size, color, opacity, rotation, preview, and local export.

tools.name: Image Combiner

tools.description_en: Combine multiple images into vertical, horizontal, or grid compositions with reordering, spacing, margins, background, and full-resolution export.

tools.name: Blur & Pixelate

tools.description_en: Blur or pixelate images online for free, including selected areas, adjustable intensity, live preview, and local browser export.

tools.description_en: Add custom borders and frames to images with adjustable thickness, padding, color, style, rounded corners, shadow, and local full-resolution export.

tools.name: Before & After

tools.description_en: Compare two images with a draggable before-and-after slider, labels, fit controls, and local full-resolution export.

tools.name: Add Text to PDF
tools.description: Add text to one or all PDF pages with precise position, size, color, rotation, opacity, and local export.
tools.description_en: Add text to one or all PDF pages with precise position, size, color, rotation, opacity, and local export.

tools.description: Compress PDF files online with local browser processing, aggressive Visual Compression presets, a Best Size Auto mode, PDF.js worker fallback, and no artificial quotas.
tools.description_en: Compress PDF files online with local browser processing, aggressive Visual Compression presets, a Best Size Auto mode, PDF.js worker fallback, and no artificial quotas.

tools.description_en: Build your real unit cost, add marketplace and payment fees, choose margin or markup, and see the selling price, profit, ROI, and break-even point.
